THE BRIEF

Create a campaign system that gives each visual and message variation a clear reason to exist.

Audience: Marketing teams preparing a focused launch or testing a new offer across social channels.

Yug & Co role: Independent concept: campaign idea, message system, creative directions and landing-page considerations.

THE APPROACH

Decisions before decoration.
